details.description: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct is Alibaba's Qwen team's vision-language Mixture-of-Experts model, with about 235 billion total parameters and roughly 22 billion active per token. It is the standard instruction-following edition of the Qwen3-VL family, released alongside a separate reasoning-enhanced 'Thinking' edition of the same size on September 23, 2025. It accepts text and image input with a native 256K-token context window, expandable to 1M tokens via YaRN per Qwen's GitHub documentation, and adds Interleaved-MRoPE positional embeddings and DeepStack multi-level Vision Transformer feature fusion for visual grounding.
advantages: Supports OCR in 32 languages, up from 19 in the prior Qwen VL generation, with improved handling of rare or ancient characters and jargon (Qwen model card).
Documented visual agent capability: recognizes on-screen elements and invokes tools to operate PC and mobile GUIs (Qwen model card).
Can generate Draw.io, HTML, CSS and JS code directly from images or videos of interfaces or diagrams (Qwen model card).
Includes 2D and 3D spatial grounding for visual reasoning and embodied-AI tasks (Qwen model card).
Text-timestamp alignment gives more precise, timestamp-grounded event localization for video temporal reasoning (Qwen model card).
disadvantages: Qwen also offers a separate 'Thinking' edition of this same model with reasoning-enhanced STEM/math performance; this Instruct edition is the standard, non-reasoning variant.

Qwen's release materials describe hours-long video understanding, but the maker's own benchmark tables for this model are published only as images, so no independently verifiable video-benchmark scores could be confirmed from the pages opened.
use_cases: Visual agent workflows that operate GUIs by recognizing on-screen elements
Converting screenshots, mockups or diagrams into Draw.io, HTML, CSS or JS code
Document and OCR understanding across many languages
Long-context and video understanding with temporal grounding
General multimodal question answering over images

sources.title: Qwen3 VL 235B A22B Instruct - Fireworks AI

notes: The maker's model card and GitHub README present all multimodal and text benchmark tables as embedded images rather than text, so no numeric evaluation scores could be verified from the pages opened; evaluations is left empty rather than guessed. OCR language support is stated only as a count (32 languages), so languages is left empty per instructions. Catalog facts list max input/output tokens as 262144, matching Fireworks' host page and the maker's stated 256K native context. Catalog facts' modality for this slug is text_input+text_output only (no image_input), unlike the sibling 'qwen3-vl-235b-a22b' catalog entry; kept per instructions even though the maker's own page describes text-and-image input, and flagged here as required.
